items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: They had people like Costeau and you know, all these people on it.

ctx.x: Wow. I see you played with Bob Rosengarden on Dick Cavett?
Oh yeah. “The Dick Cavett Show.” That was a great show. It wasn’t like Johnny Carson it was more, well I learned a lot. They had people like Costeau and you know, all these people on it.
